_comment: Paper (Minecraft) pod type — stock Pelican Paper egg, exported from the panel (PLCN_v3). Install script was patched to fetch from PaperMC's new Fill v3 API (fill.papermc.io/v3) because the legacy v2 API (api.papermc.io/v2) was sunset and started returning a JSON error that got saved as a corrupt server.jar. Re-import via EggImporterService (see README) after editing to apply to the live panel.
name: Paper
author: parker@pterodactyl.io
description: High performance Spigot fork that aims to fix gameplay and mechanics inconsistencies.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper Installation Script
# Updated to use the PaperMC "Fill" v3 API (https://fill.papermc.io/v3)
# because the legacy v2 API (api.papermc.io/v2) has been sunset.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper
API=https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
	# The v3 API groups versions under major keys (newest first); flatten them.
	ALL_VERSIONS=`curl -s ${API} | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | map(.value) | add | .[]'`

	# Is the requested version an exact match?
	VER_EXISTS=`echo "${ALL_VERSIONS}" | grep -x "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | head -n1`
	# Newest stable Minecraft release (1.x line, no -rc/-pre/-snapshot suffix).
	LATEST_VERSION=`echo "${ALL_VERSIONS}" | grep -E '^1\.' | grep -v '-' | head -n1`

	if [ -n "${VER_EXISTS}" ]; then
		echo -e "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	else
		echo -e "Specified version not found. Defaulting to the latest ${PROJECT} version"
		MINECRAFT_VERSION=${LATEST_VERSION}
	fi

	# Resolve the build (and its direct download URL) from the API.
	if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
		BUILD_JSON=`curl -s ${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/latest`
	else
		BUILD_JSON=`curl -s ${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}`
		if [ "`echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.id // empty'`" == "" ]; then
			echo -e "Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} not found for ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}, using latest build"
			BUILD_JSON=`curl -s ${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/latest`
		fi
	fi

	BUILD_NUMBER=`echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.id'`
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url'`

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Running curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	mv ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${SERVER_JARFILE}.old
fi

curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
    curl -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi
echo "eula=true" > /mnt/server/eula.txt
echo "==> EULA accepted at deploy time"

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description:
The build number for the paper release.

Leave at latest to always get the latest version. Invalid versions will default to latest.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: A URL to use to download a server.jar rather than the ones in the install script. This is not user viewable.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The version of minecraft to download. 

Leave at latest to always get the latest version. Invalid versions will default to latest.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.
